description: This file defines a FastAPI web server with endpoints for storing trace data, generating bugfix merge requests, and creating test coverage reports. It includes data models for trace items and utility integrations for Redis, exception patching, and test creation.

classes.name: SerializedObject
classes.description: Represents a serialized Python object with its type and JSON data.

classes.name: Arguments
classes.description: Holds positional and keyword arguments for function calls.

classes.name: ExceptionInfo
classes.description: Contains details about an exception, including type, value, and traceback.

classes.name: BaseExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Base class for trace items with common fields like id, timestamp, event, function, etc.

classes.name: CallExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Trace item representing a function call, including arguments and return value.

classes.name: LineExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Trace item representing a source code line execution.

classes.name: ExceptionExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Trace item representing an exception event with exception info.

classes.name: ReturnExecutionTraceItem
classes.description: Trace item representing a function return with return value.

classes.name: TraceData
classes.description: Main data model for trace logs, including validation for parsing execution trace items.

methods.name: parse_execution_trace
methods.description: Validator to parse and convert raw trace data into appropriate trace item objects.

methods.name: store_trace_log
methods.description: API endpoint to store a new trace log in Redis.

methods.name: generate_bugfix_mr
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger bugfix merge request creation via ExceptionPatcher.

methods.name: generate_test_coverage
methods.description: API endpoint to initiate test coverage creation using TestCoverageCreator.
